##### Project general facts

Four Seasons Private Residences Abu Dhabi at Saadiyat Beach is an exclusive beachfront collection of branded suites and villas delivered with the legendary Four Seasons touch. Architecture inspired by the natural surroundings is framed by lush greenery and azure water. The suites building rises above a basement and a ground floor to six residential floors, offering two-, three- and four-bedroom suites, including duplex suites, while the villas rise over two floors and offer five- and six-bedroom homes.

Amenities cover every part of daily life. Residents enjoy direct beach access, a pavilion, a residents' lounge, swimming pools and a poolside bar, along with tennis and padel courts, a spa with treatment rooms, a yoga and meditation studio and a fitness centre. Children's play areas include an internal playroom and an outdoor playground, while a residents' cinema, a games room, a meeting room, private event facilities, a cigar lounge, a golf simulator room and a pet grooming station complete the offer.

Interiors are bright, spacious and designed to flow seamlessly into terraces and gardens with sea or garden views. Suites feature generous balconies and dedicated basement storage, while villas offer expansive living areas and private outdoor spaces. Homes are delivered fully furnished. A dedicated Director of Residences and a trained team provide concierge, valet parking, round-the-clock security and personalised residence management services for every owner.

##### Location description and benefits

Saadiyat Island is Abu Dhabi's cultural and natural landmark, known for its pristine white beaches, protected dunes and nesting grounds for hawksbill turtles. The Saadiyat Cultural District is home to Louvre Abu Dhabi, Guggenheim Abu Dhabi and other world-class museums, while luxury resorts, beach clubs and fine dining venues line the coastline, creating a calm, resort-style setting for everyday life.

NYU Abu Dhabi, Cranleigh and Harrow schools and the Saadiyat Beach Golf Club are close to home, and Mamsha Al Saadiyat offers waterfront dining, cafes and boutique retail along the beach. Sheikh Khalifa Bin Zayed Highway connects the island with Yas Island, Abu Dhabi Global Market on Al Maryah Island, the city centre and Zayed International Airport, all within an easy drive, keeping the wider capital comfortably close.

Saadiyat Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most prestigious addresses in the UAE. Branded beachfront residences of this calibre are in very limited supply, supporting strong demand from high-net-worth families and premium tenants. The island's cultural offer, natural beauty and connectivity underpin long-term value and resilient resale prospects for owners and investors alike.
